name: Nooks
tagline: AI sales workspace with a parallel dialer, sequencing, signals, and coaching.
description: Nooks is an AI sales workspace where reps work alongside AI agents on outbound tasks. Its AI Dialer uses parallel dialing to connect with roughly 3x more prospects by auto-detecting live answers and skipping voicemails, alongside AI sequencing, intent signals and lead prioritization, and conversation-based AI coaching.
insight: Raised a $43M Series B led by Kleiner Perkins in Oct 2024, with roughly $70M raised in total.
edge: Built around a parallel AI dialer (~3x connects) plus call coaching — the strongest fit for high-volume phone outbound versus email-first platforms.
cons: No public pricing or free tier

references.title: Nooks announces $43M Series B and AI Sales Assistant Platform
